name: fast-hang-detection
description: Baseline with hangs detected in 5 minutes (tighter watchdog plus a heartbeat check) instead of 30.

node_causes.name: gpu_xid79
node_causes.description: GPU has fallen off the bus (XID 79): the process crashes

node_causes.name: fabric_link
node_causes.description: NVLink or InfiniBand link error; the collective usually hangs until the watchdog fires

node_causes.name: host
node_causes.description: host fault: memory, PSU, kernel panic

node_causes.name: collective_hang
node_causes.description: collective hang with no hardware fault found; the node stays in the job

job_causes.name: storage_stall
job_causes.description: data or checkpoint storage stall; the job hangs until the watchdog fires
